body:
## Desired result

An application should be able to customize validation failures with the behavior Kit provides through `handleValidationError`.

## Acceptance

A deliberately invalid remote argument produces the application’s chosen public validation result without invoking the Go function, in development and production.

## Current boundary

The matrix has no Go `handleValidationError` equivalent.

Feature matrix: https://tylergannon.github.io/skgo/features.html. Kit’s pinned source and client behavior define compatibility.

comments.body:
**Triage — 2026-10-18**

Checked against current [`main` at `920b6aca`](https://github.com/tylergannon/skgo/tree/920b6aca738a65d6c046a67f4db2373596fafd03). Classification: `bounded-hard`. 

No application-configurable Go handleValidationError equivalent was found; ordinary BadRequest/ValidationError handling is not that hook. The endpoint remains a chosen public validation shape without invoking the remote body, in development and production. Match the pinned Kit validation path and existing wire envelopes rather than exposing raw decoder diagnostics.

title: Expose Kit handleValidationError behavior for Go remotes
